mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `merchant` ( user_id, name, contact_name, contact_phone, address, business_hours, type_id, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, #{businessHours}, #{typeId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `merchant` WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM `merchant` WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM `merchant` WHERE status = 1 AND location_status = 1 AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY location_updated_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM `merchant` ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `merchant` SET name = #{name}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, address = #{address}, business_hours = #{businessHours}, type_id = #{typeId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `merchant` SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `merchant` SET longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, address = COALESCE(#{address}, address), geo_hash = #{geoHash}, location_status = 1, location_updated_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(mt.name, '其他') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `merchant` m LEFT JOIN `merchant_type` mt ON m.type_id = mt.id GROUP BY COALESCE(mt.name, '其他') ORDER BY value DESC
